title: JEE Main 2026 · 2 April · Evening Shift
sourceReference: MathonGo · JEE Main 2026, 2 April (Evening Shift). Questions and grading follow the supplied MathonGo answer key.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $\alpha,\beta$ be the roots of $x^2-3x+r=0$, and let $\alpha/2,2\beta$ be the roots of $x^2+3x+r=0$. If the roots of $x^2+6x=m$ are $2\alpha+\beta+2r$ and $\alpha-2\beta-r/2$, find $m$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $C_1:|z|=r$ and $C_2:|z-3-4i|=5$, $z\in\mathbb C$, be circles such that $C_2$ lies within $C_1$. If $z_1$ moves on $C_1$, $z_2$ moves on $C_2$, and $\min |z_1-z_2|=2$, find $\max |z_1-z_2|$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The system $x+5y+6z=4$, $2x+3y+4z=7$, $x+6y+az=b$ has infinitely many solutions. On which line does the point $(a,b)$ lie?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $a_1,a_2,a_3,\ldots$ be an arithmetic progression and $g_1=a_1,g_2,g_3,\ldots$ an increasing geometric progression. If $a_1=a_2+g_2=1$ and $a_3+g_3=4$, find $a_{10}+g_5$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the first eight terms of $\frac{1^3}{1}+\frac{1^3+2^3}{1+3}+\frac{1^3+2^3+3^3}{1+3+5}+\cdots$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: For $3\le r\le30$, $\binom{30}{30-r}+3\binom{30}{31-r}+3\binom{30}{32-r}+\binom{30}{33-r}=\binom{m}{r}$. Find $m$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $p_n$ be the number of triangles formed by joining vertices of a regular $n$-sided polygon. If $p_{n+1}-p_n=66$, find the sum of all distinct prime divisors of $n$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A man repeatedly tosses a fair coin. He gets 10 points for each head and 5 points for each tail. If the probability of getting exactly 30 points is $m/n$, where $\gcd(m,n)=1$, find $m+n$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The mean and variance of $n$ observations are 8 and 16, respectively. The first $n-1$ observations have sum 48 and sum of squares 496. Find $n$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A circle passes through the origin. Its centre is the intersection of the perpendicular lines $x+(k-1)y+3=0$ and $2x+k^2y-4=0$. The line $x-y+2=0$ meets the circle at A and B. Find $(AB)^2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let O be the origin and P and Q be points on the rectangular hyperbola $xy=12$. If the midpoint of PQ is $(1/2,-1/2)$, find the area of triangle OPQ.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The parabola $y=x^2+px+q$ passes through $(1,-1)$. If the distance from its vertex to the $x$-axis is minimum, find $p^2+q^2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
Let $P=\{\theta\in[0,4\pi]:\tan^2\theta
e1\}$. Let $S=\{a\in\mathbb Z:2(\cos^8\theta-\sin^8\theta)\sec(2\theta)=a^2,\ \theta\in P\}$. Find the number of elements in $S$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $\vec a=-\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k$ and $\vec b=\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k$. For some $\lambda,\mu\in\mathbb R$, let $\vec c=\lambda\vec a+\mu\vec b$. If $\vec c\cdot(3\hat i-6\hat j+2\hat k)=10$ and $\vec c\cdot(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)=-2$, find $|\vec c|^2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A is the foot of the perpendicular from $P(a,b,0)$ to the line $\frac{x-1}{2}=\frac{y-2}{1}=\frac{z-\alpha}{3}$. If the midpoint of PA is $(0,3/4,-1/4)$, find $a^2+b^2+\alpha^2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two adjacent sides of parallelogram PQRS are $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\hat j+\hat k$ and $\overrightarrow{PS}=\hat i-\hat j$. Side PS is rotated about P through an acute angle $\alpha$ in the plane of the parallelogram until it is perpendicular to PQ. Find $\sin^2(5\alpha/2)-\sin^2(\alpha/2)$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate $\int_0^{20\pi}(\sin^4 x+\cos^4 x)\,dx$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A polynomial $f(x)$ of degree 5 has extrema at $x=1$ and $x=-1$. If $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)/x^3=-5$, find $f(2)-f(-2)$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $f(x)=\int\frac{16x+24}{x^2+2x-15}\,dx$. If $f(4)=14\ln3$ and $f(7)=\ln(2^\alpha\cdot3^\beta)$, with $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb N$, find $\alpha+\beta$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $x=x(y)$ solve $2y^2\frac{dx}{dy}-2xy+x^2=0$ for $y>1$, with $x(e)=e$. Find $x(e^2)$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $A=\{2,3,4,5,6\}$. A relation R on $A\times A$ satisfies $(x,y)\,R\,(z,w)$ exactly when $x$ divides $z$ and $y\le w$. How many elements are in R?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&-2\\4&-2\end{pmatrix}$ and $B=\begin{pmatrix}3&9\\1&3\end{pmatrix}$. If $PA=B$ and $AQ=B$, find the absolute value of the sum of the diagonal elements of $2(P+Q)$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $A=(3,0)$. Circles with variable diameter AB touch the circle $x^2+y^2=36$ internally. Let C be the locus of B. If its eccentricity is $e$, find $72e^2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The area of the region bounded by $16x^2-9y^2=144$ and $8x-3y=24$ is $A$. Find $3(A+6\ln3)$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: At how many points in $[2,4]$ is $f(x)=\left\lfloor x^2-x-\frac12\right\rfloor$ discontinuous? Here $\lfloor\cdot\rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer function.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: What are the dimensions of the universal gravitational constant $G$ in terms of Planck's constant $h$, distance $L$, mass $M$ and time $T$?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A 0.5 kg mass touches the inner wall of a cylindrical drum of radius 4 m rotating about its vertical axis. The minimum angular speed that keeps it against the wall without falling is 5 rad/s. Find the coefficient of friction. Take $g=10$ m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Blocks of masses 2 kg and 1 kg hang from opposite ends of a string over a light, frictionless fixed pulley. They are held at rest at the same height and then released. How far, in metres, does their centre of mass travel in 2 s? Take $g=10$ m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A particle of charge $10^{-9}$ C moves in the $xy$-plane in fields $\vec E=0.4\hat j$ N/C and $\vec B=4\times10^{-3}\hat k$ T. It experiences a force $(4\hat i+2\hat j)\times10^{-10}$ N. Find its instantaneous velocity in m/s.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: The circuit shown has inputs X and Y. Which logic gate does the complete circuit implement?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A body of mass 1 kg falls to Earth from infinity. What are its speed and kinetic energy, respectively, on reaching the surface? Take Earth's radius as 6400 km and $g=9.8$ m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: When the studs of a screw gauge touch, the fifth circular-scale division coincides with the main-scale reference line. The circular scale has 100 divisions and the pitch is 0.1 mm. For a sphere, the main-scale reading is 5 mm and the 50th circular-scale division coincides with the reference line. What is the sphere's diameter in mm?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A soap bubble has surface tension 0.03 N/m. The work required to increase its diameter from 2 cm to 6 cm is $\alpha\pi\times10^{-4}$ J. Find $\alpha$. Take $\pi=3.14$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A mixture of carbon dioxide and oxygen occupies 8310 cm³ at 300 K and 100 kPa. Its mass is 13.2 g. Find the numbers of moles of carbon dioxide and oxygen, respectively. Assume ideal gases and take $R=8.31$ J/(mol·K).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: An air bubble of diameter 2 mm rises steadily at 0.5 cm/s through a liquid of density 2000 kg/m³. Find the coefficient of viscosity in poise. Take $g=10$ m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A spherical ball of mass 2 kg falls from a height of 10 m and comes to rest after penetrating 10 cm into sand. What average force, in newtons, does the sand exert on the ball? Take $g=10$ m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: An electromagnetic wave travels in free space along the $x$-direction. At a particular point and time its magnetic field is $\vec B=2\times10^{-7}\hat j$ T. Find the corresponding electric field in V/m.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Resistors of 200 Ω and 400 Ω are in series with a 100 V battery. A bulb rated at 200 V, 100 W is connected across the 400 Ω resistor. What is the potential difference across the bulb in volts?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Horizontal plates A and B are separated by $12/\pi$ cm, with A above B. Oil droplets of radius 1 mm and density 1.5 g/cm³ are sprayed horizontally. Each carries a charge of 5 nC. Which potentials $V_A,V_B$, respectively, keep the droplets from descending? Neglect air resistance and take $g=10$ m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Point charges of 8 μC and −2 μC are at $x=2$ cm and $x=4$ cm, respectively. What is the ratio of the electric fluxes through two spheres centred at the origin with radii 3 cm and 5 cm, respectively?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: One face of an equilateral prism is coated with a transparent material of refractive index $n_2$. The prism has refractive index 1.6. For the ray shown, find the minimum value of $n_2$ required for total internal reflection from the coated face.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: In the series LCR circuit shown, the phase difference between current and source voltage is 30° when switch $S_1$ is closed and $S_2$ is open. It is 60° when $S_2$ is closed and $S_1$ is open. Find $3L_1-L_2$ in henries.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A circular loop of radius $R$ is inside a square loop of side $L$, where $L\gg R$. The loops are coplanar and concentric. If the permeability of free space is $\mu_0$, what is their mutual inductance?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Find the binding energy per nucleon of $^{209}_{83}\mathrm{Bi}$ in MeV. Take its mass as 208.980388 u, $m_p=1.007825$ u, $m_n=1.008665$ u and $1\ \mathrm{u}=931\ \mathrm{MeV}/c^2$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A particle moves according to $x=a\sin(50t+\pi/3)$ cm. It comes to rest at time $t_1$ and has zero acceleration at time $t_2$. Find $t_1$ and $t_2$, respectively.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: In Young's double-slit experiment, the intensity at a point on the screen is three quarters of the maximum intensity. The path difference there is $\lambda/x$, where $\lambda$ is the incident wavelength. Find $x$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Using Bohr's model, find the ratio of the magnetic fields produced by the electron's motion in the second and fourth orbits of a hydrogen atom, respectively.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Five moles of an unknown gas are heated at constant volume from 10 °C to 20 °C. Its molar heat capacity at constant pressure is 8 cal/(mol·°C). Take $R=8.36$ J/(mol·°C). Find the change in internal energy in calories.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Sunlight focused onto paper by a convex lens burns it in the shortest time when the lens is 30 cm above the paper. The radius of curvature of the lens is 60 cm and its material has refractive index $\alpha/10$. Find $\alpha$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A uniform rod of mass 40 kg and length 3 m has the same moment of inertia about axis AB as a solid sphere of mass 10 kg and radius $R$ about an axis parallel to AB and separated from it by 3 m, as shown. If $R=\sqrt{\alpha/2}$, find $\alpha$.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: The mass-percentage ratio C : H in a hydrocarbon is 12 : 1. Each molecule has two carbon atoms. What mass of CO₂, in grams, forms when 3.38 g of the hydrocarbon burns completely in oxygen? Molar masses in g/mol: C = 12, H = 1, O = 16.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: The first and second ionization constants of a weak dibasic acid H₂A are $8.1\times10^{-8}$ and $1.0\times10^{-13}$, respectively. A 0.1 mol sample of H₂A is dissolved in 1 L of 0.1 M HCl. Find the concentration of HA⁻.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
Which species are isostructural with SF₄?
A. BrF₄⁻
B. CH₄
C. IF₄⁺
D. XeF₄
E. XeO₂F₂

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Gas A changes from state X to state Y, absorbing 10 J of heat and doing 18 J of work. It returns to X by another process, during which it releases 6 J of heat. Which statement describes the return process?

options.text: The gas does 18 J of work.
The gas does 2 J of work.
The surroundings do 12 J of work on the gas.
The surroundings do 14 J of work on the gas.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Solution A contains 1 g of a protein of molar mass 50,000 g/mol in 0.5 L of water at 300 K. Its osmotic pressure is $x$ bar. Solution B contains 2 g of the same protein in 1 L of water at 300 K and has osmotic pressure $y$ bar. Mixing the entire solutions at the same temperature gives osmotic pressure $z$ bar. Find $x,y,z$, respectively. Take $R=0.083$ L·bar/(mol·K).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: At 25 °C, 20.0 mL of 0.2 M weak monoprotic acid HX is titrated with 0.2 M NaOH. Find the pH (a) before NaOH is added and (b) after 10 mL has been added. Given $K_a=5\times10^{-4}$, $\mathrm pK_a=3.3$, and $\alpha\ll1$.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
For the reaction $aX\to bY$, the rate constant at 30 °C is $1\times10^{-3}$ L/(mol·s). Which statements are true?
A. Increasing the concentration of X fourfold increases the rate sixteenfold.
B. The reaction is second order.
C. The half-life is independent of the concentration of X.
D. Decomposition of N₂O₅ is an example of this reaction type.
E. A plot of $\ln([R_0]/[R])$ versus time is valid for this reaction.

options.text: A, B, D and E only

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which set contains all four types of oxide: basic, acidic, amphoteric and neutral?

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
Statement I: The second ionization enthalpies of B, Al and Ga follow B > Al > Ga.
Statement II: The first ionization enthalpies follow Si < Ge < Pb < Sn.
Which statements are true?

options.text: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
Statement I: Among Zn, Mn, Sc and Cu, the energy required to remove the third valence electron is highest for Zn and lowest for Sc.
Statement II: The increasing order of crystal field stabilization energy is [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ < [Co(H₂O)₆]³⁺ < [Co(en)₃]³⁺.
Which statements are true?

options.text: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
Which complexes show coordination isomerism?
A. [Ag(NH₃)₂][Ag(CN)₂]
B. [Co(NH₃)₆][Cr(CN)₆]
C. [Co(NH₃)₆][Co(CN)₆]
D. [Fe(NH₃)₆][Co(CN)₆]
E. [Co(NH₃)₆][Fe(CN)₆]

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Complete combustion of a sample gives 0.25 g of CO₂ and 0.12 g of H₂O. The sample contains 25% carbon and 4.89% hydrogen by mass. If the sample mass is $X\times10^{-3}$ g, find $X$ to the nearest integer. Molar masses in g/mol: C = 12, H = 1, O = 16.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
Statement I: In O₂N–C₆H₄–CH⁺–C₆H₄–OCH₃, the carbocation is stabilized by the +R effect of –OCH₃.
Statement II: In O₂N–C₆H₄–CH⁻–C₆H₄–OCH₃, the carbanion is stabilized by the −R effect of –NO₂.
Which statements are true?

options.text: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Compound X gives 2,4-dimethylpentane on heating with anhydrous AlCl₃ and HCl gas. It gives toluene on aromatization and methylcyclohexane on cyclization. What is X?

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
Which statements about alkyl halides (R–X) are correct?
A. Alcohol is less polar than water, and alcoholic KOH favours elimination with R–X.
B. Reactivity towards the $S_\mathrm{N}1$ mechanism follows C₆H₅–CH₂–Cl > C₆H₅–CHCl–C₆H₅.
C. Unsubstituted aryl halides exhibit properties similar to alkyl halides.
D. Vinyl chloride is a haloalkene and allyl chloride is a haloalkyne.
E. R–Cl can be prepared from R–OH with SOCl₂, but Ar–Cl cannot be prepared from Ar–OH with SOCl₂.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: An organic compound X contains C, O and H in equal molar amounts and has molar mass 58 g/mol. Treatment with 50% KOH under reflux followed by acidification gives Y. Which structure is most likely for Y?

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
Compound X, CH₃–CH=CH–O–C(CH₃)=CH₂, hydrolyses under mildly acidic conditions to give Y and Z. Which statements about Y and Z are correct?
A. They have the same molar mass.
B. NaHCO₃ can distinguish them.
C. They react with HCN at the same rate.
D. They undergo addition reactions with 2,4-DNP.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Start with 1-ethyl-4-nitrobenzene. The sequence is Br₂/AlBr₃ → A; Sn/HCl → B; NaNO₂/HCl at 273–278 K → C; C₂H₅OH → D; then (i) KMnO₄/KOH and (ii) H₃O⁺ → E. Identify A and E. In the descriptions of A, ethyl is at ring position 1.

options.text: A: Br at 3, NO₂ at 4. E: 3-bromobenzoic acid.
A: Br at 2, NO₂ at 4. E: 2-bromobenzoic acid.
A: Br at 2, NO₂ at 4. E: 2-bromo-4-hydroxybenzoic acid.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which pair gives an amino acid and its iodinated hormone derivative, respectively? T and Y are one-letter amino acid codes.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Among Fe²⁺, Fe³⁺, Cr²⁺ and Zn²⁺, which ion gives a positive borax bead test and has the highest ionization enthalpy?

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Sodium is irradiated with light of wavelength $x$ nm. The ejected electrons have kinetic energy $2.8\times10^{-20}$ J and the work function is 2.3 eV. Express $x$ as a multiple of $10^2$ and enter the multiplier to the nearest integer. Take $h=6.6\times10^{-34}$ J·s, 1 eV $=1.6\times10^{-19}$ J and $c=3.0\times10^8$ m/s.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: The reaction $2A(g)\to4B(g)+C(g)$ takes place in a closed vessel at 25 °C. At 30 min the total pressure is 300 mm Hg; at infinite time it is 600 mm Hg. Find the partial pressure of C at 30 min in mm Hg, to the nearest integer.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
The standard reduction potentials are:
CO₂ + 6H⁺ + 6e⁻ → CH₃OH + H₂O, 0.02 V
½O₂ + 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂O, 1.23 V
A fuel cell using these half-reactions operates at 1 bar and 298 K with 80% efficiency. The work from using 1 mol of CH₃OH compresses an ideal gas isothermally against a constant pressure of 1 kPa. Find the signed volume change in m³ to the nearest integer. Take $F=96500$ C/mol.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
How many of these ions are paramagnetic?
Mn²⁺, Cu²⁺, Zn²⁺, Yb²⁺, Sc³⁺, La³⁺, Gd³⁺, Lu³⁺, Ti⁴⁺, Ce⁴⁺.
Atomic numbers: Mn 25, Cu 29, Zn 30, Yb 70, Sc 21, La 57, Gd 64, Lu 71, Ti 22, Ce 58.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Starting with para-nitrotoluene, apply the sequence (i) Sn/HCl, then OH⁻; (ii) (CH₃CO)₂O; (iii) Br₂/AlBr₃; (iv) H₃O⁺, giving major product P. In Carius analysis with AgNO₃, how many grams of AgBr precipitate from 1.0 g of P? Give the nearest integer. Molar masses in g/mol: C = 12, H = 1, O = 16, N = 14, Br = 80, Ag = 108.
